name: Fast Oscillation: Short Wavelength
description: Set the electron to oscillate rapidly. Observe tightly packed wave crests -- the EM equivalent of a high-frequency signal (e.g. FM radio ~100 MHz, or WiFi ~2.4 GHz).

successCriteria.description: Observe tightly packed wave crests at high frequency

hints.message: Fast oscillation = short wavelength. This is like an FM radio or WiFi signal.
The electron (blue dot) vibrates rapidly -- you may notice the field arrows change direction quickly.
